text:
- If the athlete fails, the main spotter will yell 'take it' and wrap their arms around the torso to help the athlete return to an erect position
- The side spotters will simultaneously grab each end of the barbell to assist the main spotter and athlete if a repetition is failed. All three spotters should assist evenly to ensure the safest condition for the athlete and spotters
- If the spotters assist in the repetition, the athlete and all three spotters should walk the weight back to be racked
book: BASICS OF STRENGTH AND CONDITIONING MANUAL
